sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Go UP 4 times from rows 45-49, cols 49-53
actions = ['UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'UP']
for a in actions:
    result = action([a])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            print(f"After {a}: Orange boundary={n['boundary']}, gameplay_changed={result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

# Now LEFT 3 times
actions = ['LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT']
for a in actions:
    result = action([a])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            print(f"After {a}: Orange boundary={n['boundary']}, gameplay_changed={result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

# Now DOWN
result = action(['DOWN'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O':
        print(f"After DOWN: Orange boundary={n['boundary']}, gameplay_changed={result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
print(f"level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")

# Now try all directions from here
for d in ['UP', 'DOWN', 'LEFT', 'RIGHT']:
    result = action([d])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            print(f"After {d}: Orange boundary={n['boundary']}, gameplay_changed={result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
    print(f"level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
